fixed.item: M3 / A4: stale static-index caches outside the journal (save/load divergence of T-50c78da60ad2a8-01; 10 stale indexes in 6 domains)
fixed.how: World.static_index has a contract that makes its content a pure function of the state: the set of entities whose record as it was when the current step began matches the predicate, plus or minus the entities created or destroyed since (at once). Every predicate evaluation reads the record through a view that notes the fields it reads; when a step commits, a changed entity becomes pending in exactly the indexes that read one of its changed fields (thermal's temperature writes, read by no index, cost nothing); creations, destructions and rollbacks (rollback, rollback_to) are applied at the next lookup; a caller may declare its read fields (reads=, used by of_type and the kernel's puddle index). Strict mode also checks that a predicate answers the same on its read view and that declared reads are complete. World._version is kept unchanged for the camera and sight memos.

fixed.item: H14 / A1: the stack law broke 8 specs under the forced 'ready' laws (bowl on a kitchen scale; ironing board's folded size)
